### You Are Welcome Here
Author: Stephen Witmer
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/you-are-welcome-here
Passage: Romans 15:7
Points:
- Christian welcome goes far beyond superficial Sunday handshakes to genuine gospel fellowship.
- Christ welcomed sinners at great personal cost to reconcile them into God's household.
- Believers are called to treat each other like family across personal, cultural, and opinion differences.
- Welcoming one another requires humble, everyday acts of service from the entire congregation.
- A church displaying sacrificial love and unity demonstrates God's glory and worth to the world.

### Abounding in Hope
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/abounding-hope
Passage: Romans 15:13
Points:
- Christ fulfilled ancient scripture by securing salvation and hope for both Jews and Gentiles.
- God is the divine source and guarantor who supplies joy and peace to those who trust Him.
- Believers' spiritual peace and joy rest on objective reconciliation with God rather than fleeting feelings.
- Meditating on our eternal hope produces endurance and guards the heart amid temporal hardships.
